question: Choose the word which fits in the blank labelled 2 and gives appropriate meaning.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the passage** discusses studies in population which implies that research or investigation has been carried out in this area.**
 
• Option 1 (shared) is incorrect as studies are typically conducted, not just shared.
 
• Option 2 (provided) is incorrect as it implies offering information which doesn't fit the context of performing research.
 
• Option 3 (given) is incorrect as it is not specific enough to the context of conducting studies.
 
• **Option 4 (conducted) correctly fits the context as it implies that the studies were carried out or performed in this area.**

Therefore, the correct option is **Option 4.**
